context: Reference implementation: UnaryOperator registry with an identity entry.

checklist.name: Creates the requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates TrackNameNormalizers.java with both methods, needed imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves normalizer behavior
checklist.description: as-is returns the input unchanged, uppercase upper-cases, collapsed strips and collapses internal whitespace runs, the map is unmodifiable, and an unknown mode throws IllegalArgumentException that names the mode.

checklist.name: Uses UnaryOperator.identity for the unchanged entry
checklist.description: The as-is entry is UnaryOperator.identity() (with its import), not name -> name, Function.identity() cast to UnaryOperator, or a custom identity method.

checklist.name: Uses glue callbacks for the other entries
checklist.description: uppercase and collapsed are method references or one-expression lambdas (for example String::toUpperCase and a named helper for collapsing), with no block lambdas in the map definition.

checklist.name: Stays focused
checklist.description: No unrelated abstractions, caching, configuration loading, or extra public API.

metadata.reference_selection: Candidate for main promotion; classify from the isolated hosted run.
